]> 21/08/2026 7:25 Conditions improving throughout the day.

This morning there's still a bit of precipitation and high cloud about, but the forecast is for the weather to clear as the day wears on.

It's currently 1.2 degrees with a top of 5 degrees forecast, and winds are 33km/h gusting up to 60km/h from the west to north-west. Winds may impact some lift operations early on, so keep an eye on the lift report for real-time updates.

We're expecting 32 lifts to open today, with 31 groomed runs out there. The team are working hard to repair damage from the recent weather and keep terrain open. The snow should be soft and fun from the outset.

It's the last day of State Interschools, with Alpine and Moguls running as scheduled on Front Valley and Mogul Matts. Ski Cross is also on, running as one run only. Snow Australia will provide updates on any changes.

Don't forget we have great savings at Slopestyle and Perisher Sports, with up to 50% off select products!
